cases.expected_translation_substr: How did you spend the day

cases.input_text: Saro pe7adii, Gofatho AI? Nu so asay maallado guuraara denddidi nena sarothees.
cases.source_authority: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1 & 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 88)

cases.input_text: Saro, Xoossi galatetto! Hintte so asay ubbay saro pe7idetii? Maallado tukke uyishe lo77o gallassa doommite.
cases.source_authority: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1 & 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 88)

cases.input_text: Ee, ubbaykka saro de7ees. Ta aaway goshsha baanaw giigettees, ta aayiyakka tukke kathawsu.
cases.source_authority: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1 & 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 88)

cases.input_text: Daro ufayssiyaabaa! Ne aawaas ooso anjjo, ne aayeeskka payyatethaanne ufayssaa Xoossi immo.
cases.source_authority: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1 & 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 88)

cases.input_text: Saro ooladii? Gallassa oosuwaa wurssada ha77i soo geladis.
cases.source_authority: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 94)

cases.input_text: Saro ooladis, galatays! Saron soo gelido gishshaw ufayttays. Ha77i guutha wode shemppanaw bessikkii?
cases.source_authority: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 94)

cases.input_text: Ee, guutha shemppada ta naytara keetha-ooso xeellana. Nayti timirtte keethappe simmidi tana naagoosona.
cases.source_authority: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 94)

cases.input_text: Hegee daro lo77o aawa kanddo! Nayta timirttiyan maaddanaassi taanikka Goofatho qawosa oyshota birshshanaw giiga de7ays.
cases.source_authority: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 1 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 94)

cases.input_text: Goofatho doonan so asaa sunthata taassi qonccisarkkii? Aawa, aayee, ishaanne michchiyaappe harati oonee?
cases.source_authority: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, Appendix D Kinship Lexicon)

cases.input_text: Ufayssan! Goofatho doonan: aawa aaway woy aayee aaway 'maayza' geetettees; aawa ishay 'gutha aawa', aayee ishay 'vooce', qassi aawa michchiyaa 'aayee gutha' geetettawsu.
cases.source_authority: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, Appendix D Kinship Lexicon)

cases.input_text: Daro lo77o! Ta maayzaynne ta aayee aayiyaa Sawula kataman de7oosona. Wontto enttana oychchanaw baana.
cases.source_authority: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, Appendix D Kinship Lexicon)

cases.input_text: Bayrata oychchoynne bonchchoy Goofa dere gita woga. Enttako gakkiya wode "Saro de7idetii, ta maayzatoo?" gada sarotha!
cases.source_authority: Grade 8 Goofatho Doona Ch. 3 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/160NHNy-4orPcAIk-L5t6tOEtZoWemz_-/view?usp=drivesdk); Sellassie Cheru (2015, Appendix D Kinship Lexicon)

cases.input_text: Imatati nu soo yidosona. Goofa wogan tukke katho maaraa koyroppe doomada taassi odarkkii?
